bead.title: bench-pr-A3d: per-cell transient retry with backoff + supersede links
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Transient adapter/executor failures (connection refused, 5xx, EOF parse) should not poison a cell. The runner must retry with bounded backoff and leave an auditable chain so a forensic reader can follow attempt_of -> superseded_by between the retry cell and the cell it replaced.

ROOT CAUSE:
- Retry-on-transient and the closed-cell link mutation are ported from cmd/bench/matrix.go's run loop (the same loop carrying the budget checks at cmd/bench/matrix.go:806/933).
- Bash anchors: run_cell_with_per_cell_retry is declared at scripts/benchmark/benchmark:138 and its body sketch lives at scripts/benchmark/benchmark:1006-1034 (exponential backoff, retry-log.txt for forensics). The attempt_of/superseded_by link-writing helper is shared with A3b's invalid/orphan path; A3d owns the transient-retry caller.

PROPOSED FIX (scripts/benchmark/benchmark):
- Detect transient errors (connection refused, HTTP 5xx, EOF/parse) from adapter/executor exit and output; retry with bounded exponential backoff, capturing each attempt to cell_dir/retry-log.txt.
- On retry, mint a new cell carrying attempt_of: <prior cell id> and back-write superseded_by: <new cell id> into the prior closed cell (the one permitted mutation of a closed cell).
- Exhausting retries yields a terminal final_status (e.g. transient_exhausted) per the front end's status vocabulary (scripts/benchmark/benchmark:895).

NON-SCOPE: arg parsing / matrix / --plan (A2); adapters + image (A1); core per-cell loop + report.json composition (A3a, prerequisite); resume/skip + --retry-invalid (A3b); budget accounting + halt placeholders (A3c); flock/setsid/job-pool concurrency and SIGINT/SIGTERM handling (A4); Go agent-leak fix, Go deactivation, parity (A5). Parent out-of-scope preserved: PR B schema; PR C bench-set schema; PR D collector; PR E importers; PR F deleting cmd/bench; PR G docs. Governing artifact: docs/helix/02-design/plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.md.

DEPENDS ON: A3a (and transitively A2, A1). BLOCKS: A4.

ACCEPTANCE (satisfies parent A3 AC4):
1. A transient adapter failure (simulated via scripts/benchmark/test/fixtures/transient-harness) yields a retry cell carrying attempt_of: and a superseded_by: back-written into the prior cell, with each attempt logged to retry-log.txt. TestPerCellRetryLinks (cmd/bench/runner_a3_test.go) plus a bats case in scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats exercising the transient fixture.
GATES: bats scripts/benchmark/test (and scripts/benchmark/tests/runner.bats) pass; `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance: Parent A3 AC4 holds; acceptance 1 passes; bats, go test ./..., and lefthook run pre-commit all green.
